description: This file defines an Android activity named AnimatedNotificationDisplayActivity that displays an animated notification with image zoom and translation animations. It includes a nested helper class ImageZoomView for zooming effects, manages animation creation and lifecycle, and handles UI setup for animated notifications.

classes.name: AnimatedNotificationDisplayActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays an animated notification with moving and zooming images, managing animation lifecycle and user interaction.

classes.name: AnimatedNotificationDisplayActivity.ImageZoomView
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that enlarges the contained ImageView on layout to create a zoom effect.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the view, and starts the first animation.

methods.name: createNextAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts the next translation animation for the ImageView, recursive upon animation end.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the animation when the activity is resumed.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the ongoing animation when the activity is paused.
